Title: 1. One Hundred and One Dalmatians
description: When a litter of Dalmatian puppies are abducted by the minions of Cruella De Vil, the owners must find them before she uses them for a diabolical fashion statement.

Title: 2. West Side Story
description: Two youngsters from rival New York City gangs fall in love, but tensions between their respective friends build toward tragedy.

Title: 3. Seong Chun-hyang
description: Chun-hyang, the only daughter of an old gisaeng named Wolmae, falls in love with Lee Mong-nyong and promises to marry him. But Lee leaves for Seoul with his father who's an aristocrat, and the new governor, Byeon Hakdo, covets Chun-hyang because she is the most beautiful girl in town. When Chun-hyang rejects his order to serve him at night, Governor Byeon sends her to jail. In the mean time, Lee passes the state exam and becomes a special undercover agent of the king. He comes back to where Chun-hyang lives to save her and punishes Governor Byeon.

Title: 4. A Woman Is a Woman
description: A stripper who's desperate to become a mother accepts her reluctant boyfriend's suggestion that she be impregnated by his best friend.

Title: 5. Last Year at Marienbad
description: In a strange and isolated chateau, a man becomes acquainted with a woman and insists that they have met before.

Title: 6. Lola
description: A bored young man meets with his former girlfriend, now a cabaret dancer and single mother, and soon finds himself falling back in love with her.

Title: 7. Léon Morin, Priest
description: Set during occupied France, a faithless woman finds herself falling in love with a young priest.

Title: 8. A Difficult Life
description: Silvio refuses to fight for the fascists and joins the resistance with Elena. After the war, his vitriolic newspaper articles cause him to be sentenced to imprisonment.

Title: 9. Yojimbo
description: A crafty ronin comes to a town divided by two criminal gangs and decides to play them against each other to free the town.

Title: 10. La Notte
description: A day in the life of an unfaithful married couple and their steadily deteriorating relationship.

Title: 11. The Exiles
description: Follows a family of Native Americans living in the City of Angels.

Title: 12. Il posto
description: Bursting with big dreams and plans, an Italian teen goes to Milan to work in a big impersonal corporate office, where he becomes disillusioned and drained of all his individualism.

Title: 13. Breakfast at Tiffany's
description: A young New York socialite becomes interested in a young man who has moved into her apartment building, but her past threatens to get in the way.

Title: 14. Lover Come Back
description: A series of misunderstandings leaves an advertising executive with a campaign for a product which has not yet been invented, while he romances his rival in the guise of its inventor.

Title: 15. Judgment at Nuremberg
description: Fictionalized depiction of the 1947 Judges' Trial, the third of 12 trials of Nazi war criminals conducted by the American occupying forces in Nuremberg, Germany, in which former judges of Nazi Germany were tried for their actions.

Title: 16. The Guns of Navarone
description: A team of Allied saboteurs is assigned an impossible mission: infiltrate an impregnable Nazi-held Greek island and destroy the two enormous long-range field guns that prevent the rescue of 2,000 trapped British soldiers.

Title: 17. The Hustler
description: An up-and-coming pool player plays a long-time champion in a single high stakes match.

Title: 18. The Innocents
description: A young governess for two children becomes convinced that the house and grounds are haunted.

Title: 19. The Parent Trap
description: Teenage twin sisters swap places and scheme to reunite their divorced parents.

Title: 20. El Cid
description: The fabled Spanish hero Rodrigo Diaz de Vivar (a.k.a. El Cid) overcomes a family vendetta and court intrigue to defend Christian Spain against the Moors.

Title: 21. The Human Condition III: A Soldier's Prayer
description: His ideals challenged by life as a conscript in war-time Japan's military, a pacifist faces ever greater tests in his fight for survival.

Title: 22. The Children's Hour
description: A schoolgirl ruins her two headmistresses with a scandalous lie.

Title: 23. Splendor in the Grass
description: The relationship between two high school sweethearts is threatened by the oppressive expectations of their parents and society in small-town Kansas in 1928.

Title: 24. Through a Glass Darkly
description: Recently released from a mental hospital, Karin rejoins her emotionally disconnected family in their island home, only to slip from reality as she begins to believe she is being visited by God.

Title: 25. Murder She Said
description: When Miss Jane Marple reports witnessing a murder through the window of a passing train, the police dismiss her as a dotty spinster when no trace of the crime can be found.

Title: 26. The Misfits
description: A divorcée falls for an over-the-hill cowboy who is struggling to maintain his romantically independent lifestyle.

Title: 27. The Pit and the Pendulum
description: In the sixteenth century, Francis Barnard travels to Spain to clarify the strange circumstances of his sister's death after she had married the son of a cruel Spanish Inquisitor.

Title: 28. One, Two, Three
description: In West Berlin during the Cold War, a Coca-Cola executive is given the task of taking care of his boss' socialite daughter.

Title: 29. The Curse of the Werewolf
description: In eighteenth-century Spain, an adopted boy becomes a werewolf and terrorizes the inhabitants of his town.

Title: 30. A Raisin in the Sun
description: A substantial insurance payment could mean either financial salvation or personal ruin for a poor black family.

Title: 31. Mother Joan of the Angels
description: A priest is sent to a small parish in the Polish countryside which is believed to be under demonic possession and there he finds his own temptations awaiting.

Title: 32. The Day the Earth Caught Fire
description: When the U.S. and Russia unwittingly test atomic bombs at the same time, it alters the nutation (axis of rotation) of the Earth.

Title: 33. Mothra
description: An expedition to Infant Island uncovers a native tribe and twin tiny fairy priestesses of a mythical deity, who sets out to rescue the pair after they are kidnapped by a greedy businessman.

Title: 34. A Taste of Honey
description: A pregnant teenage girl must fend for herself when her mother remarries, leaving the girl with only a new male friend for support.

Title: 35. The Phantom Planet
description: After an invisible asteroid draws an astronaut and his ship to its surface, he is miniaturized by the phantom planet's exotic atmosphere.

Title: 36. One-Eyed Jacks
description: A man seeks revenge against a former accomplice who betrayed him.

Title: 37. Paris Blues
description: During the 1960s, two American expatriate jazz musicians living in Paris meet and fall in love with two American tourist girls.

Title: 38. Accattone
description: A pimp with no other means to provide for himself finds his life spiraling out of control when his prostitute is sent to prison.

Title: 39. Scream of Fear
description: A wheelchair-bound young woman returns to her father's estate after 10 years, and although she's told he's away, she keeps seeing his dead body on the estate.

Title: 40. Voyage to the Bottom of the Sea
description: When the Earth is threatened by a burning Van Allen Radiation Belt, U.S. Navy Admiral Harriman Nelson plans to shoot a nuclear missile at the Belt, using his experimental atomic submarine, the Seaview.

Title: 41. Ten Dark Women
description: A man has a wife and nine girlfriends, all ten of whom are fed up with his shameless polygamy and plot to kill him. However, this is easier said than done.

Title: 42. Viridiana
description: Viridiana, a young nun about to take her final vows, pays a visit to her widowed uncle at the request of her Mother Superior.

Title: 43. Divorce Italian Style
description: A married Sicilian baron falls in love with his cousin and vows to wed her, but with divorce illegal he must concoct a crime of passion to do away with his wife.

Title: 44. Babes in Toyland
description: Mary Contrary is set to marry Tom Piper when he is kidnapped by Roderigo and Gonzorgo, two goons working for the evil Barnaby who wants to marry Mary for her inheritance.

Title: 45. Night Tide
description: A young sailor is attracted to a mysterious mermaid performing at a carnival, but soon suspects that the girl is actually a siren who draws men to their watery deaths during the full moon.

Title: 46. The Steamroller and the Violin
description: Seven-year-old Sasha practices violin every day to satisfy the ambition of his parents. Already withdrawn as a result of his routines, Sasha quickly regains confidence when he accidentally meets and befriends worker Sergei, who works on a steamroller in their upscale Moscow neighborhood.

Title: 47. Harry and the Butler
description: Set in the late fifties in Denmark the poor junk yard assistant Harry inherits some money. He decides to use the money to hire a butler. The butler isn't too keen on the job at first, but he takes it because there aren't that many butler-jobs around at the moment. In the beginning both of them don't know what to expect of the other, but find a way to satisfy both of them. The people in the neighborhood at first make jokes about Harry and his butler, but in the end they start to accept him when he starts to help them.

Title: 48. Homicidal
description: The brutal stabbing murder of a justice of the peace sparks an investigation of dark family secrets in a sleepy Southern California town.

Title: 49. The Absent Minded Professor
description: A college professor invents an anti-gravity substance which a corrupt businessman wants for himself.

Title: 50. Whistle Down the Wind
description: When an injured wife murderer takes refuge on a remote Lancashire farm, the owner's three children mistakenly believe him to be the Second Coming of Christ.

Title: 51. Pocketful of Miracles
description: New York bootlegger Dave the Dude and his girlfriend Elizabeth "Queenie" Martin try to turn boozy street beggar Apple Annie into a society lady when Annie learns that her daughter Louise is marrying the son of a Spanish count.

Title: 52. Princess of Cleves
description: Princess of Cleves is married with a rich and old prince but she loves secretly a lord younger, more beautiful and also very popular.

Title: 53. Mr. Sardonicus
description: A mysterious and cruel Baron, whose face has become frozen in a horrifying grin, demands that a prominent London physician apply experimental treatments on him to restore his face.

Title: 54. Barabbas
description: Governor Pontius Pilate gave the populace a choice to spare either Barabbas, a criminal, or Jesus, condemned as a heretic, from crucifixion. The masses chose Barrabas, and he is haunted by the image of Jesus for the rest of his life.

Title: 55. The Ladies Man
description: A clueless, recently-single graduate unwittingly takes a job as a servant in a mansion inhabited by dozens of young women.

Title: 56. Blast of Silence
description: A hired killer from Cleveland has a job to do on a second-string mob boss in New York, but a special girl from his past and a gun dealer with pet rats get in his way.

Title: 57. Time of the Heathen
description: A drifter witnesses a rape/murder. The perpetrator's father falsely accuses the drifter and orders his son to kill the drifter and another witness, the victim's mute son.

Title: 58. The Roman Spring of Mrs. Stone
description: An aging actress travels to Rome with her husband; after he suddenly dies during the flight, she begins a passionate affair with a young gigolo.

Title: 59. Creature from the Haunted Sea
description: A crook decides to bump off members of his inept crew and blame their deaths on a legendary sea creature. What he doesn't know is that the creature is real.

Title: 60. Payroll
description: A gang plans to steal a factory's wages, but an armored van foils them. They rob anyway, killing the driver. His vengeful wife and encroaching police make the gang betray each other.

Title: 61. The Shadow of the Cat
description: A house cat sees her mistress murdered by two servants under orders from her husband, and becomes ferociously bent on revenge.

Title: 62. The Assassin
description: While in police custody on suspicion of murdering his wealthy mistress, a young antiquarian recalls past episodes of his sordid life to determine what has led him to his current predicament.

Title: 63. Pigs and Battleships
description: A young hoodlum decides to work for a criminal organization that is tearing itself apart.

Title: 64. Parrish
description: In the Connecticut River Valley, Parrish McLean and his mother are newly employed by the Sala Post tobacco farm that is engaged in a competition war with the neighboring Judd Raike tobacco corporation.

Title: 65. Chronicle of a Summer
description: A documentary about the everyday lives of ordinary Parisians, done in the style of cinéma vérité.

Title: 66. Constantine and the Cross
description: Biopic of Constantine the Great, set between 293-312 AD, from his days as Tribune to his accession as Roman Emperor of Gaul under the tetrarchy system and ending with his battle against the usurper Roman Emperor Maxentius in Rome.

Title: 67. Placido
description: An ill-advised charity campaign encouraging wealthy citizens to break bread with the less fortunate sweeps across a small industrial Spanish town on Christmas Eve.

Title: 68. Victim
description: A closeted lawyer risks his career to bring a blackmailer to justice.

Title: 69. A Fever in the Blood
description: The murder of a socialite leads to a sensational trial, with a close governor's race hanging on its outcome.

Title: 70. Piesen o sivom holubovi
description: During WW2, a group of Slovak children goes on a trip to the mountains with their teacher.

Title: 71. Blue Hawaii
description: After arriving back in Hawaii from the Army, Chad Gates defies his parents' wishes for him to work at the family business and instead goes to work as a tour guide at his girlfriend's agency.

Title: 72. Mysterious Island
description: During the Civil War a group of Union soldiers, a Confederate and a civilian escape the stockade using a hot-air balloon and end up on a strange Pacific island.

Title: 73. Two Rode Together
description: A corrupt marshal is pressured by his army friend into negotiating the release of white captives of the Comanches, but finds that their reintegration into society has its consequences.

Title: 74. Flower Drum Song
description: A young woman arrives in San Francisco's Chinatown from Hong Kong with the intention of marrying a rakish nightclub owner, unaware he is involved with one of his singers.

Title: 75. King of Kings
description: The life and times of Jesus against a background of Roman paganism. Set in Palestine, depicts the Jews under Roman rule and their struggle for freedom under the leadership of Barabbas, the man who was spared while Jesus was crucified.

Title: 76. The Comancheros
description: A Texas Ranger captures a fugitive and returns him to Louisiana to face sentence, but soon they are forced to work together in an effort to defeat a fierce band of outlaws dealing with the Comanches known as Comancheros.

Title: 77. The Last Sunset
description: At a Mexican ranch, fugitive O'Malley and pursuing Sheriff Stribling agree to help rancher Breckenridge drive his herd into Texas where Stribling could legally arrest O'Malley, but Breckenridge's wife complicates things.

Title: 78. The 7th Commandment
description: A car wreck gives Ted amnesia. He becomes an evangelist with a preacher's help. His new success leads his ex and her boyfriend to blackmail him over missing money. As his memory returns, Ted believes that he killed the other driver.

Title: 79. Come September
description: Younger generation vs. "older" folks on vacation at an Italian villa.

Title: 80. Bandits of Orgosolo
description: Sardinian shepherds Michele, Peppeddu encounter bandits. Michele evades police, sheep perish. Wrongly charged with murder, impoverished, Michele turns outlaw. He resorts to violence, banditry for survival, fueling a lawless spiral.

Title: 81. X-15
description: During the Cold War in the 1960s the U.S.A.F. and NASA tested the experimental rocket-powered aircraft X-15 that set altitude and speed records and reached the edge of outer space.

Title: 82. The Secret Ways
description: During the 1956 Hungarian uprising, an American mercenary is hired to smuggle a Hungarian resistance leader out of Soviet-occupied Budapest.

Title: 83. Romulus and the Sabines
description: Based on the Roman foundation myth during the mid-8th century BC. Romulus leads a daring plan to abduct women from the neighboring Sabines. A conflict evolves into a struggle for peace, unity, and the survival of a rising civilization.

Title: 84. Nude on the Moon
description: A rich rocket scientist organizes an expedition to the moon, which they discover is inhabited by nude women.

Title: 85. Man Called Rocca
description: (1961) Jean Paul Belmondo, Christine Kaufman. In this fine thriller, JP's friend ends up in prison. JP then tracks down the man responsible.

Title: 86. The Colossus of Rhodes
description: While holidaying in Rhodes, an Athenian war hero becomes involved in two plots to overthrow the tyrannical king: one from Rhodian patriots, and the other from sinister Phoenician agents.

Title: 87. Bachelor in Paradise
description: A bachelor author of sleazy books moves to a family-oriented subdivision where he becomes an unofficial relationship advisor to unhappy local housewives, to the dismay of their respective husbands who suspect him of sexual misconduct.

Title: 88. The Frightened City
description: A small-time thief is recruited by a mobster to help with his racketeering. He doesn't like the job, but with the mob on his back, a femme fatale in his bed and a sick friend to care for, he will have to keep all his wits about him.

Title: 89. Ring of Fire
description: In the 1960s Oregon, two sheriff deputies arrest three teenagers for robbery but are overpowered and taken hostage while forest fires rage all around them.

Title: 90. The Mask
description: A young archaeologist thinks he is cursed by an Aztec mask that makes him have strange nightmares. Before committing suicide, he sends the mask to his psychiatrist, who soon plunges into the mask's nightmarish world.

Title: 91. Girl with a Suitcase
description: A girl pursues a guy who fooled her, but fascinates his younger brother instead.

Title: 92. Goodbye Again
description: A successful businesswoman, dissatisfied with her current, philandering lover, starts an affair with a much younger man.

Title: 93. Gidget Goes Hawaiian
description: Gidget, on vacation in Hawaii, finds a gang of lads vying for her attention, starting a chain of romantic complications when her boyfriend arrives.

Title: 94. Vacations in Acapulco
description: A tour bus reaches Acapulco, with each passenger carrying their own personal story of drama or comedy.

Title: 95. Master of the World
description: In 1868, an American scientist and his team become hostages of fanatical pacifist Robur who uses his airship Albatross to destroy military targets on Earth.

Title: 96. Naked as Nature Intended
description: Three girls on a tour of the English countryside meet up with two young women who introduce them to the joys of life in a nudist camp.

Title: 97. The Deadly Companions
description: An ex-army officer accidentally kills a woman's son and tries to make up for it by escorting the funeral procession through dangerous Indian territory.

Title: 98. Fanny
description: Young Marius dreams of leaving his dull provincial life and seeing the world. When the beautiful Fanny declares her adoration for him, Marius must choose between an adventurous life at sea and the grandest adventure of all: love.

Title: 99. The Naked Edge
description: Five years after George Radcliffe was the chief witness in a high profile murder case, his wife receives a blackmailing letter accusing him of the crime.

Title: 100. Gorgo
description: Greedy sailors capture a giant lizard off the coast of Ireland and sell it to a London circus, inciting the wrath of the creature's much-larger mother.

Title: 101. Atlantis: The Lost Continent
description: Welcome to Atlantis, where royal guardsmen wear uniforms that could easily be from the wardrobe of Ming the Merciless and some unfortunate slaves are turned into bovine-headed beasts.

Title: 102. Bhabhi Ki Chudiyan
description: In a joint family, Geeta manages home despite being childless. Her world turns upside down when her brother-in-law's marriage brings new dynamics and maternal interference.

Title: 103. Something Wild
description: A simple mechanic's love saves a rape victim in Manhattan.

Title: 104. Greyfriars Bobby: The True Story of a Dog
description: The remarkable veritable story of a terrier named Bobby and the enduring friendship he forges with a tenderhearted shepherd known simply as Old Jock---unbroken even by the kindly old man's death.

Title: 105. The Choppers
description: A gang of teenage delinquents terrorize a small community by stealing cars and stripping them for parts, then selling the parts to a crooked junkyard owner. The police and an insurance company investigator set out to break up the gang.

Title: 106. Diary of a Nudist
description: Editor sends reporter to expose a nudist camp, but she loves the lifestyle and writes positive articles. Frustrated by her response, he visits the camp himself to write his own story.

Title: 107. A Thunder of Drums
description: The trials and tribulations of bitter veteran Captain Maddocks and argumentative rookie Lieutenant McQuade at a cavalry desert outpost.

Title: 108. Wild in the Country
description: A troubled young man discovers that he has a knack for writing when a counselor encourages him to pursue a literary career.

Title: 109. The Devil at 4 O'Clock
description: A crusty, eccentric priest recruits three reluctant convicts to help him rescue a children's leper colony from a Pacific island menaced by a smoldering volcano.

Title: 110. Erik the Conqueror
description: Two estranged brothers confront each other as rivals when war breaks out between Britain and the Vikings for control of England.

Title: 111. Hercules in the Haunted World
description: Hercules must journey into Hades itself to retrieve the magic stone that will free his love from the powers of darkness.

Title: 112. The Connection
description: Eight heroin addicts in a Manhattan loft apartment allow a documentary crew to film them to pay for their fix. As they wait for their dealer, they confront the filmmakers, challenging the voyeuristic motives behind the project.

Title: 113. Cash on Demand
description: A charming but ruthless criminal holds the family of a bank manager hostage as part of a cold-blooded plan to steal 97,000 pounds.

Title: 114. Back Street
description: A chance encounter leads to romance between an aspiring designer and a Marine. After their paths diverge, she builds a fashion career in NYC. Years later, they reunite, but new opportunities abroad challenge their rekindled connection.

Title: 115. Hercules and the Captive Women
description: Strong yet sleepy Hercules discovers that the Queen of Atlantis is plotting to take over the world with superhuman warriors.

Title: 116. Underworld U.S.A.
description: A teenager who witnesses the murder of his father vows to exact revenge on the four mobsters involved in the killing.

Title: 117. House of Mystery
description: A couple wants to buy a house. An inventor owned it and was electrocuted in his laboratory. A later owner had problems with the lights and the appearance of a ghost. A psychic is consulted who reveals the secret behind the house.

Title: 118. Amphibian Man
description: The residents of a coastal town are frightened by reports of an unknown creature in the sea.

Title: 119. The Young Savages
description: A district attorney investigates three white teenagers accused of murdering a blind Puerto Rican kid.

Title: 120. Tintin and the Mystery of the Golden Fleece
description: Tintin and Captain Haddock try to discover what is so desirable about their old and apparently worthless ship.

Title: 121. Erotica
description: A sensational journey into female sexuality told in six segments: "Naked Innocence", "Beauties, Bubbles, and H2O", "The Bare and the Bear", "Nudists on the High Seas!", "The Nymphs" and "Bikini Busters!".

Title: 122. Francis of Assisi
description: In 13th century Italy, Francis Bernardone, the son of an Assisi merchant, renounces a promising army career in favor of a monastic life and starts his own religious order, sanctioned by the Pope.

Title: 123. Please, Not Now!
description: Sophie's boyfriend plans to leave her for another woman. Sophie considers winning him back or eliminating her rival. A doctor interested in Sophie helps her pursue reconciliation to avoid violence.

Title: 124. The Naked Witch
description: A student researching the German settlements of Central Texas unearths the grave of a reputed witch. The witch rises from her grave nude and embarks on a campaign of seduction and murder against the descendants of her persecutors.

Title: 125. Werewolf in a Girls' Dormitory
description: At a girls' school, several students are murdered by a snarling, wolfman-like creature. Suspicion falls upon a newly-arrived teacher.

Title: 126. The Last Time I Saw Archie
description: An enlisted conman and his sidekick bluff their way through World War II.

Title: 127. Konga
description: Dr. Decker comes back from Africa. During one year, he came across a way of growing plants and animals to an enormous size. He brings back a baby chimpanzee and he decides to use him, Konga, to get rid of his enemies.

Title: 128. The Illiterate One
description: A man who cannot read or write is given a letter that says he is the inheritor of two million pesos, which starts off a series of events regarding his job, love, and education.

Title: 129. Paris Belongs to Us
description: The indiscreet Terry, mistress of an American journalist, revealed to her lovers, Juan and Gérard, something they should never have known.

Title: 130. The Mark
description: A man who served prison time for intent to molest a child tries to build a new life with the help of a sympathetic psychiatrist.

Title: 131. Reptilicus
description: After copper miners discover a piece of the frozen tail of a giant prehistoric reptile in Lapland, scientists inadvertently bring it back to life.

Title: 132. Havoc in Heaven
description: Sun Wukong, the King of the Monkeys, sets off on his first adventure to gain a worthy weapon. This earns the attention of the Jade Emperor of Heaven.

Title: 133. The Young Doctors
description: Two pathologists clash over critical cases at their big-city hospital.

Title: 134. Carry on Regardless
description: The Helping Hands agency employs some very strange people to perform some equally strange jobs. Even the simplest of tasks get bungled by the incompetent but lovable staff.

Title: 135. The Terror of the Tongs
description: In 1910, Hong Kong members of a secret Tong crime syndicate protect their identities by murdering the daughter of a British sea captain who vows revenge.

Title: 136. Summer and Smoke
description: A plain, repressed spinster falls for a dashing young medical student who prefers the wilder life, until it's too late.

Title: 137. The End of Summer
description: The family of an older man who runs a small sake brewery become concerned with his finances and his health after they discover him visiting an old mistress from his youth.

Title: 138. The Trojan Horse
description: A retelling of the events leading to the use of the Trojan Horse, to bring down the great city of Troy.

Title: 139. La ragazza in vetrina
description: Italians migrate to Holland to make money in coal mining. After their first work accident, two friends make different future plans: one spends money on a weekend holiday; the other determines to return to Italy soon.

Title: 140. Pagan Island
description: The survivor of a shipwreck finds himself on an island populated only by women.

Title: 141. Town Without Pity
description: Four American soldiers stationed near a German village face the death penalty in the rape of a local girl, and are defended by outside counsel Major Steve Garrett.

Title: 142. La viaccia
description: A patriarch's death sparks a family power struggle. Son Ferdinando tries to seize full control of the deceased's property, but nephew Amerigo resists until he meets prostitute Bianca.

Title: 143. Too Late Blues
description: Ghost is an ideological musician who would rather play his blues in the park to the birds than compromise himself. However, when he meets and falls in love with beautiful singer Jess Polanski, she comes between him and his band members, and he leaves his dreams behind in search of fame.

Title: 144. The Second Time Around
description: In 1911, a widow with two children leaves New York City for territorial Arizona and becomes a ranch hand and later gets herself elected sheriff. A gambler and a rancher become rivals for her affections.

Title: 145. All in a Night's Work
description: Tony Ryder takes over his dead uncle's media empire while trying to keep quiet the mysterious circumstances of his death in a Palm Beach hotel room.

Title: 146. The Outsider
description: Tony Curtis plays an Indian (Nicknamed "Chief" by other soldiers) who fights in WWII and helps to raise the flag at Iwo Jima.

Title: 147. Cuba baila
description: The conflicts of a mother who wants, beyond her means, to organize the best possible quinceañera party for her daughter.

Title: 148. The Errand Boy
description: A goofy paperhanger is hired to root out a financial inefficiency on a Hollywood studio lot, wreaking havoc as he goes.

Title: 149. Atlas Against the Cyclops
description: Strongman Maciste must battle the one-eyed Cyclops monster that is ravaging the land of Sadok, while at the same time fending off the advances of the evil Queen Capys, who wants to do a little ravaging of her own.

Title: 150. The President
description: Former President Beaufort still plays a central role in the country's political life. Writing his memoirs allows him to look back on his career and discuss his relationship with Chamalont, who is about to become Prime Minister.

Title: 151. Five Minutes to Live
description: A murderous thug and his partner take a bank executive's wife hostage as part of their plan to rob the bank but things turn out to not be as simple as planned.

Title: 152. Duel of the Titans
description: Twin brothers revolt against tyranny in pre-Roman Italy and then come to a parting of the ways as they lead their people toward the founding of a new city.

Title: 153. The Counterfeiters of Paris
description: "Le Dabe" retired many years ago and now he lives in the tropics where he owns stables and horses. He is a very rich man. He was the king of all money counterfeiters. He is contacted from Paris to organize a new job. He says no. But when he finds out the the currency to be counterfeited is the Dutch florin, he accepts immediately. He retired after having counterfeited 100 florin notes just before the Queen Wilhelmina retired them from circulation. He flies to Paris. But the gang is not to be trusted, at least not all of them.

Title: 154. The Pleasure of His Company
description: Jessica Poole, is marrying Roger Henderson. When her father arrives, he disrupts the household of his ex-wife and befriends their cook.

Title: 155. Madame
description: Catherine, a laundress, joins lover Lefevre in war. Their heroics help Napoleon win. As a reward, they're granted nobility. Catherine's lack of courtly etiquette shocks high society, but she remains authentic despite her new rank.

Title: 156. Dondi
description: Six American GIs stationed in Italy befriend an orphaned boy, but the soldiers remain unaware that the lad has stowed away with them when they return to the U.S.

Title: 157. Gunga Jumna
description: Gungaram, a poor, indebted farmer, works hard to educate his younger brother Jumna and make him a police officer. Years later, circumstances force Gungaram to become an outlaw and now the brothers confront each other as enemies.

Title: 158. Wonderful to Be Young!
description: Youths must raise £1500 to save youth club from demolition by unscrupulous developer. They record song, broadcast it via pirate radio as "Mystery Singer" ploy to raise funds. Main character has secret he can't share with girlfriend.

Title: 159. Three Daughters
description: Based on popular Indian stories of the great writer Rabindranath Tagore, these short films reveal definitive moments in the lives of three young girls.

Title: 160. Doctor Blood's Coffin
description: People are mysteriously disappearing near a remote Cornish village, where a scientist is experimenting; reviving the dead.

Title: 161. A Majority of One
description: A gentle love story about a Japanese businessman and widower, and a Brooklyn widow. But before a happy ending can ensue, they must learn again the lessons of tolerance, kindness, and forgiveness.

Title: 162. On the Double
description: At the time of the invasion of Normandy, an American soldier is asked to impersonate a British general in order to confuse German spies and assassins in London.

Title: 163. The Beast of Yucca Flats
description: A defecting Soviet scientist is hit by a nuclear explosion near Yucca Flats and roams around as a beast.

Title: 164. The Devil's Hand
description: A man is haunted by visions of a beautiful woman. When he finally meets her, he winds up involved in a Satanic cult.

Title: 165. Tammy Tell Me True
description: A wholesome river girl floats her boat to college and meets a professor who finds her charming.

Title: 166. Snow White and the Three Stooges
description: An ice-skating Snow White finds refuge from the Wicked Queen with the Three Stooges.

Title: 167. The Thief of Baghdad
description: In the time of the Arabian Nights, the city of Baghdad is ruled by Sultan Ali Bajazeth but actually controlled by the scheming Grand Vizier Ghamal. The poor of Baghdad are aided by Karim, the Thief of Baghdad.

Title: 168. The George Raft Story
description: A Broadway dancer with mob connections rises to Hollywood stardom.

Title: 169. Bridge to the Sun
description: Based on a true story, this compelling drama relates the difficulties of a young woman married to a Japanese diplomat during World War II, victim of suspicion and animosity from her husband's government.

Title: 170. The Man in the Back Seat
description: Two young thugs rob a bookie leaving a dog-racing track with his winnings, but when they grab his case full of money they discover that he has chained it to his wrist. They dash around town trying to find a way to separate the case from the wrist of the bookie, who the pair has by now beaten so badly he appears to be dead. They finally come up with what they think is a foolproof plan, but soon something happens that they weren't quite expecting.

Title: 171. Fear No More
description: A woman recently released from psychiatric care is accused of the murder of a woman found dead in her compartment. Arrested and taken off the train, she escapes custody and flees to her apartment, where she finds another murder victim.

Title: 172. Return to Peyton Place
description: The residents of Peyton Place are not happy after its most famous resident, Alison Mackenzie, writes a shocking" novel detailing the sinful secrets of the town.

Title: 173. Mad Dog Coll
description: Story of Vincent "Mad Dog" Coll, a notorious gangland killer in the 1930s.

Title: 174. Antigone
description: Antigone defies her uncle's decree that her traitorous brother should go unburied and therefore find no rest in the afterlife; however, her actions have tragic consequences.

Title: 175. The Invincible Gladiator
description: A Roman warrior leads a revolt against an evil ruler.

Title: 176. Posse from Hell
description: Banner Cole is a tough sheriff's deputy who forms a small posse to go after 4 death cell escapees who killed the sheriff , along with 3 other men, and kidnapped a woman with rape in mind.

Title: 177. By Love Possessed
description: Neurotic woman engages in an affair with the law partner of her impotent husband.

Title: 178. The Best of Enemies
description: In 1941 during the desert war in Abyssinia the Italian captain Blasi and the British major Richardson alternate between being bitter enemies or best friends depending on the circumstances.

Title: 179. Call Me Genius
description: Tony Hancock gives up his day job to become an artist. He's a lot of enthusiasm, but little talent, and critics dislike his work. Nevertheless, he impresses a talented artist.

Title: 180. The Ghost Story of Oiwa's Spirit
description: A samurai plots to reclaim his estranged wife after she leaves him over a murder scandal. When her sister falls victim to a scheme, he and his friend manipulate events, but their plans lead to supernatural vengeance.

Title: 181. Bloodlust!
description: A crazed hunter kidnaps people and turns them loose on his private estate, where he hunts them for sport.

Title: 182. Duel of Champions
description: In the 5th century BC, rival kingdoms Rome and Alba entrust their fate to a duel to death between their respective chosen champions, the 3 Orazi brothers for Rome and the 3 Curiazi brothers for Alba.

Title: 183. The Honeymoon Machine
description: A navy lieutenant and his civilian friend use a classified computer to help them break the bank at a Venetian casino.

Title: 184. Spotlight on a Murderer
description: When he learns his days are numbered old count Hervé de Kéraudren decides to hide in a secret alcove and to die there, just to annoy his heirs. As a result of his body not being found the latter will have to wait for five years until they can inherit the count's money. Very upsetting indeed, all the more as they are required to keep up the Kéraudren estate in the meantime. To collect money, nephews and nieces organize a Son et Lumière show at the manor while busily looking for the missing corpse. But, unexpectedly, they get killed in turns. Murders or accidents? Jean-Marie, his fiancée Micheline and his cousin Edwige investigate and finally succeed in exposing the culprit. And, the count's body being found by chance, all goes back to normal.

Title: 185. The Story of the Count of Monte Cristo
description: Edmond Dantes is falsely accused by those jealous of his good fortune, and is sentenced to spend the rest of his life in the notorious island prison, Chateau d'If. While imprisoned, he meets the Abbe Faria, a fellow prisoner whom everyone believes to be mad. The Abbe tells Edmond of a fantastic treasure hidden away on a tiny island, that only he knows the location of. After many years in prison, the old Abbe dies, and Edmond escapes disguised as the dead body. Now free, Edmond must find the treasure the Abbe told him of, so he can use the new-found wealth to exact revenge on those who have wronged him.

Title: 186. Battle of the Worlds
description: A runaway asteroid dubbed "The Outsider" mysteriously begins orbiting the Earth and threatens it with lethal flying saucers.

Title: 187. Jungle Fighters
description: In 1942, a group of British soldiers is sent on a mission in the Malaysian jungle and gets lost in the Japanese-controlled zone.

Title: 188. The Important Man
description: Animas Trujano is a colorful but irresponsible Indian in a small Mexican village. He hopes above all things someday to be chosen mayordomio of his village, a place of great honor usually conferred upon the wealthiest and most respected citizens. Animas has a loyal wife, but cheats on her and gambles away every cent they raise. Chances arise for Animas to turn over a new leaf and even hope realistically for the honor of mayordomio. But will Animas behave responsibly enough to take advantage of these opportunities?

Title: 189. The Three Musketeers: Part I - The Queen's Diamonds
description: In order to join the Musketeers, young D'Artagnan is embroiled in a plot in which Cardinal of Richelieu tries to take control of power from the King of France, along with Rochefort and Milady de Winter,

Title: 190. El resplandor
description: It tells the story of a slave rebellion on a sugar plantation in the days leading up to the official abolition of slavery on the island of Puerto Rico on March 22, 1873.

Title: 191. Loss of Innocence
description: Teenage Joss Grey vacations in France with her family. Her mother falls ill, leaving her in the care of a hotel manager having an affair with a charming older man towards whom Joss develops an attraction, transitioning from girl to woman.

Title: 192. Valley of the Dragons
description: In 1881, in Algeria, Michael Denning and Hector Servadac are fighting a duel when a comet brushing Earth takes the two men to the Moon where they discover a prehistoric civilization.

Title: 193. No Place Like Homicide!
description: Ernie's uncle has just died, but to claim his inheritance he must spend the night in the ancestral home with the rest of his relatives. Before long, the guests begin to drop dead.

Title: 194. Girls of the Night
description: A prostitute tries to change her life after the enforcement of an anti-prostitution law.

Title: 195. The Happy Thieves
description: A suave art thief romances a wealthy duchess, only to enable him to steal a priceless painting from her collection. Complications ensue.

Title: 196. Bachelor Flat
description: British college professor seeks peace in a California beach house but has nothing but trouble from an uninvited female 'juvenile delinquent', a neighbor with a mischievous dog, and a bevy of amorous American woman.

Title: 197. Eve and the Handyman
description: Dressed in a long raincoat, Eve follows the handyman around as he makes his appointed rounds. She witnesses humorous run-ins on his various errands. But why is she watching him so carefully?

Title: 198. Misty
description: Every year the Chincoteague fire department rounds up the wild ponies of Assateague Island, and then auctions off the colts and yearlings to thin out the herd. A young brother and sister, Paul and Maureen Beebe, have set their hearts on owning one particular wild three-year-old pony, The Phantom. Only they have to earn the money, the Phantom has to be captured in the roundup (which she never has), and then they have to outbid everyone else for her in the auction. And even the Phantom herself has a surprise for Paul and Maureen: a foal named Misty.

Title: 199. The Last Judgment
description: In Naples, a voice from the skies announces one morning that the final judgment will be at 6 p.m. on that day. What follows is a series of vignettes depicting various people's reactions (or lack thereof) to the announcement.

Title: 200. Taxi for Tobruk
description: During World War II, French commandos join forces with a German officer in order to survive the African desert.

Title: 201. Shangri-La
description: Sammy, a zookeeper, prepares to go on a vacation with his friend. He starts to tell his friend about what a good time he had on his last vacation, visiting alligator farms and nudist camps, which are shown in flashbacks.

Title: 202. The Hoodlum Priest
description: Based on the life of Fr. Charles Clark, a minister to street gangs.

Title: 203. Samson and the 7 Miracles of the World
description: Sam must rescue a beautiful Chinese princess from a marauding horde of warriors.

Title: 204. Fury at Smugglers' Bay
description: Pirate wreckers ravage a small seaside community while the ineffectual local squire tries to discourage his son's romance with a smuggler's pretty daughter.

Title: 205. Hum Dono
description: When an army officer is presumed dead in battle, his lookalike is tasked with breaking the news to his family. However, circumstances force him to impersonate the dead man.

Title: 206. Sail a Crooked Ship
description: An odd assortment of criminals steals a mothballed Liberty vessel to use it as a getaway after a planned bank robbery in Boston.

Title: 207. Queen of the Nile
description: Chronicles the rise and fall of the woman who eventually became known as Queen Nefertiti.

Title: 208. The Singer Not the Song
description: In a small Mexican town, a Catholic priest (Sir John Mills) and a local bandit (Sir Dirk Bogarde) clash, but the brave priest ultimately wins the outlaw's respect.

Title: 209. Susan Slade
description: A poor writer rivals a rich man's son for a young woman with a secret out-of-wedlock child.

Title: 210. The Joy of Living
description: Ulysse is a naive young man out looking for a job after being released from the army. He drops the offer he gets from a group of fascists to go in with the Fossatis, a family of anarchists (unknown to him).

Title: 211. Nudist Life
description: A quintet of ringers in a Florida nudist colony.

Title: 212. Look in Any Window
description: A teenager's parents finally realize how bad their home life is when their son is arrested for prowling.

Title: 213. The Third Alibi
description: A married composer finds that his affair with his wife's half-sister has resulted in her death.

Title: 214. Black Gravel
description: A West German trucker who illegally sells black gravel reunites with a former lover, now married to an American.

Title: 215. Cry for Happy
description: U.S. Navy photographic team uses Tokyo geisha house as its home.

Title: 216. Anatomy of a Psycho
description: The crazed brother of a condemned killer sent to the gas chamber swears vengeance on those he holds responsible for his brother's execution.

Title: 217. The Long Absence
description: A Parisian café owner believes her long-lost husband has returned but the man suffers from amnesia.

Title: 218. Dead Eyes of London
description: Wealthy, heavily-insured men are being murdered at an alarming rate. Scotland Yard investigates and finds clues that lead to a ring of blind men, led by a mysterious "reverend."

Title: 219. Gold of the Seven Saints
description: In Seven Saints, Utah, McCracken's outlaw gang is vying for fur trappers Jim Rainbolt and Shaun Garrett's gold nugget fortune that also catches the eye of Mexican bandit Gondora and his caballeros.

Title: 220. The Snake Woman
description: While investigating unusual snakebite deaths in a rural village, a Victorian Scotland Yarder charms a cold-bloodied beauty.

Title: 221. Satan's Sword 3: The Final Chapter
description: Disguised as a beggar monk, Ryunosuke's harrassed along the road by the rowdy members of a country dojo or fencing school malingering outside their fencing hall.

Title: 222. The Night Before Christmas
description: Surreal Soviet-era Christmas fantasy movie.

Title: 223. Aimless Bullet
description: A pressured accountant, his war veteran brother and their dysfunctional family struggle with integrating into post-War Korean society.

Title: 224. On the Fiddle
description: During World War II, a street peddler invents a story about enlisting, which convinces the magistrate to send him to the RAF instead of prison. A new loyal friend goes along with his schemes to avoid work, but eventually duty calls.

Title: 225. Sampoorna Ramayana
description: This is the story of Lord Ram and his years spent in exile with his wife and brother, and also chronicles the end of the demon king Ravan and his family.

Title: 226. The Sins of Rachel Cade
description: While the Nazi regime subjugates European nations during World War II, in the Belgian Congo nurse Rachel Cade tries to cure the local people. Colonel Derode falls in love with her, but an injured young American pilot upsets his plans.

Title: 227. Operation Eichmann
description: With the defeat of Germany that ends World War II in Europe, the Allies discover the true horror of more than six million Jews slaughtered by the Nazis - and the fact that one of the architects of this unimaginable crime has escaped. Adolf Eichmann flees to Barcelona and Argentina and the Israeli agents are determined to bring him to justice.

Title: 228. Romanoff and Juliet
description: Concordia, a powerless European country, holds the deciding vote in a UN resolution. The U.S. and Soviet Union manipulate Concordia, but its leader challenges them by playing matchmaker.

Title: 229. Snow White
description: Hated by her jealous and bloodthirsty stepmother, Snow White flees a murder attempt and seeks shelter in the woods with seven kindly dwarfs. Feeling she is safe from harm, Snow White welcomes the disguised queen into her home...with fatal consequences.

Title: 230. A Wife Confesses
description: Ayako is charged with murdering her much older academic husband while climbing a mountain. Ayako was having an affair, apparently with her husband's approval, and this complicates the trial.

Title: 231. Wise Guys
description: Ronald, an idler living on the Left Bank in Paris, is determined to inflict a terrible revenge on his friend Arthur, after the latter subjected him to a harmless joke. He engages the services of the seductive Ambroisine, who pretends to fall in love with Arthur. Oblivious to his friend's scheming, Arthur is certain that Ambroisine's feelings for him are genuine and looks forward to their wedding day.

Title: 233. The Mongols
description: During the Mongol invasion of Poland, a conflict between Mongol Emperor Genghis Khan and his oldest son Ogotai ensues when the former aims for peace and the latter itches for war and conquest.

Title: 234. Honeymoon of Terror
description: A couple honeymoons on a deserted isle called Thunder Island. When the husband leaves the island to go for supplies, the wife finds that the island isn't as deserted as they thought it was.

Title: 235. The Marriage-Go-Round
description: A Swedish woman wants her American host to father her baby.

Title: 236. Famous Love Affairs
description: Anthology of four love stories that have some historical basis.

Title: 237. Buddha
description: An Indian prince leaves his world of comfort and riches behind to wander and meditate for six years in search of spiritual enlightenment. Siddartha turns his back on the old religion when people are starving needlessly.

Title: 238. Go Naked in the World
description: The son of a successful Greek emigrant is torn between his father's expectations for him and his passionate love affair with a beautiful prostitute.

Title: 239. The Queen's Guards
description: Grenadier Guards Captain John Fellowes prepares for the Trooping the Colour ceremony and reminisces about his years at Sandhurst Military Academy as well as his family's dramatic life.

Title: 240. Two Half-Times in Hell
description: On Hitler's birthday, the Germans decide to organize a soccer match between prisoners of war and Germans.

Title: 241. The Passion of Slow Fire
description: Stéphane Blanchon teaches at International College and lives quietly in Geneva with his wife Christine. His love life is nonexistent until Belle arrives to stay in his villa.

Title: 242. Joseph and His Brethren
description: A brother is cast out from his family, sold in to slavery and then returns years later as a man of power - but shows forgiveness and compassion to his family through the strength of character given to him by God.

Title: 243. Nikki, Wild Dog of the North
description: The rugged Canadian wilderness is the backdrop to this story of a dog separated from his owner.

Title: 244. Junglee
description: A humorless and pompous businessman goes wild when he falls in love. Now if only his domineering mother could understand his new lease on life.

Title: 245. No Love for Johnnie
description: After winning re-election, British Labour Party M.P. Johnnie Byrne faces a series of setbacks in his political career, as well as in his marriage, and must act wisely in order to save both.

Title: 246. Ghosts of Rome
description: Several ghosts in an ancient palazzo in Rome join together to save their home from destruction. Mastrianni plays several parts and is hilarious. The other actors are great too.

Title: 247. Mole Men Against the Son of Hercules
description: Maciste is captured and taken to an underground city. The queen takes note of his beauty and strength, and chooses him to be her consort if he can overcome a series of challenges.

Title: 248. Striped Trip
description: A comedy about tigers and lions running around a cruise ship full of passengers.

Title: 249. Man with the Funky Hat
description: Ichiro, the son of a private detective, is a part-time convertible salesman who spends his time picking up girls, through which he becomes involved in the investigation of the kidnapping of the son of a government official.

Title: 250. Boy Friend
description: A young lad, separated at a young age from his parents takes on the life of petty crime and ends up in jail. On his release he comes across a friend in a train, and at the friend's request sets upon to trace his two daughters; he meets them and falls in love with one of them. But the police are on his trail due to a stolen necklace belonging to none other than his birth mother.

Title: 251. Le capitaine Fracasse
description: The ruined Baron Philippe de Sigognac, meets one day a troupe of traveling actors. Attracted by Isabelle, and by the enthusiasm of his acting companions, he joins the troupe.

Title: 252. Pirates of Tortuga
description: An English captain is sent to Spanish-controlled Tortuga to deal with privateer Henry Morgan who defected from England and now runs a pirate operation, plundering all ships, including English vessels,

Title: 253. In the Doghouse
description: British comedy about the ups and downs of a London vet.

Title: 254. An Angel Has Appeared
description: Marisol's parents are dead, and she must sell everything she has and go to Madrid to live with her Uncle Ramon's family. Her aunt Leonor is a very bad woman who doesn't like her or treat her as one of the family, forcing her to eat her meals in the kitchen with the maid, Herminia. She only lets Marisol stay because she brought a lot of money with her and the family is not doing well at the moment. The family includes two adult cousins and a younger girl cousin, and Marisol secretly brought along a little friend she met on the train into Madrid.

Title: 255. A cavallo della tigre
description: An inept thief wants to escape prison and return to his family, but two of his prison mates also want out.

Title: 256. Damaged Goods
description: A high-school track star's wedding plans are capsized by venereal disease and a bad, beautiful new girl in town. His coach and a physician steer him into the light again.

Title: 257. Why Bother to Knock!
description: A romantically active travel agent gives all of his girlfriends keys to his flat - too many to keep count of.

Title: 258. Walk the Angry Beach
description: A young girl comes to Hollywood to try to break into films, but ends up being taken advantage of by sleazy producers and is forced to become a stripper.

Title: 259. Ring of Terror
description: A group of medical students undertake some silly and frightening endeavors in order to pledge a fraternity.

Title: 260. Twenty Plus Two
description: A famous movie star's fan-club secretary has been brutally murdered. She has in her office old newspaper clippings regarding a missing heiress. Did the secretary know something about the mystery of the heiress? Tom Alder investigates.

Title: 261. Saptapadi
description: Set in World War II, the reverend Krishnendu runs a military hospital in Bankura. A drunken Anglo-Indian woman soldier is brought to him for treatment and he recognized her as his former love Rina Brown.

Title: 262. Immortal Love
description: A young woman is forced by circumstance into a loveless marriage while still in love with another. This episodic tale follows their story through three decades of bitter conflict which engulfs their children and those around them.

Title: 263. Love in a Goldfish Bowl
description: A college student and his best female friend and fellow student plan to spend the Easter holidays together. Then an Italian seaman shows up and creates a love triangle.

Title: 265. The Miracle of the Wolves
description: In the 15th century France, only one honest knight stands up on protection of a young noblewoman when she finds herself trapped in enmity between a king and a treacherous nobility.

Title: 266. The Bacchantes
description: The god Dionysus decides to pay a visit to the city of Thebes.

Title: 267. The American Beauty
description: Marcel, a simple-minded factory worker, is tricked into buying a high-priced American convertible by a widow determined not to let it fall into the hands of her late husband's secretary/secret lover. Once in possession of the car, Marcel only encounters one bad luck episode after another with the excessive gasoline consumption, his wife trying to sell it to make ends meet, getting into traffic jams, accidentally riding into a car wash with the top down, and more.

Title: 268. We Were Young
description: The film takes us back to the days of Bulgarian Resistance during Second World War. Beautiful love between two young people burns out against the background of the Nazi reality.

Title: 269. The Adventures of Lucky Pierre
description: A man imagines that everybody he sees is naked. He goes to see a psychiatrist to see if he can be cured.

Title: 270. Battle at Bloody Beach
description: In 1941, after the Japanese invasion of the Philippines, American civilian Craig Benson helps organizing the Philippine guerrilla fighters, delivering supplies and evacuating stranded civilians.

Title: 271. The Wonders of Aladdin
description: A poor young man finds a magic lamp that possesses a genie, who will grant the boy three wishes if he sets him free from the lamp.

Title: 272. Flight That Disappeared
description: A cross-country airliner, whose passengers include a nuclear physicist, a rocket expert, and a mathematical genius, is drawn beyond radar range by an unknown, unbreakable force.

Title: 273. Line
description: (1961 aka LINE) Margarete Robsahm, Toralv Maurstad, Henki Kolstad, Elisabeth Bang.. Youthful drama about a young guy and his struggles with his hatred of his father. Not even a relationship with a good-looking girl seems to cool his emotions. This video has been manufactured from the best quality video master currently available; audio or image quality may vary.

Title: 274. The Green Archer
description: An English businessman comes home to London, only to find visitors to his home being killed by arrows from "the Green Archer."

Title: 275. Sanctuary
description: William Faulkner's steamy tale set in the South in the 1920s. Governer's daughter is seduced and raped by a Cajun who returns after she's married to cause her further trouble.

Title: 276. Støv på hjernen
description: Comedy about the people in an apartment building.

Title: 277. The Return of Dr. Mabuse
description: Inspector Lohmann is back, this time investigating the murder of an Interpol agent. After another murder is committed, he teams up with an FBI agent, which leads them to investigate brainwashed prison inmates committing crimes.

Title: 278. Jungle Street Girls
description: Terry Collins mugs an old man, who subsequently dies. Joe Lucas finds out about it and blackmails him, threatening to turn him in to the police if he doesn't give him money. Terry then plans to rob the safe at a night club with his friend Johnny, who is the boyfriend of a stripper (Jill Ireland) that Terry's infatuated with.

Title: 279. Miyamoto Musashi
description: The film begins when the legendary swordsman Miyamoto Musashi is still named Shinmen Takezo. After being on the losing side of the Battle of Sekigahara, Takezo and his friend manage to escape and come across a young woman and her mother.

Title: 280. Teresa
description: Teresa es una muchacha humilde que vive en una vecindad junto a sus padres, quienes trabajan arduamente para poder pagar los estudios de su hija. Teresa sueña con tener la gran vida llena de lujos y comodidades avergonzandose de sus padres y de su condicion. Ella se relacionará con diferentes hombres mientiendo y ocultando todo aquello acerca de su condición social.

Title: 281. Angel Baby
description: A young woman's transformation from healed to healer incurs many dramatic changes, some of which are much more apparent than others.

Title: 282. Ada
description: Political drama about an honest but naive gubernatorial candidate who is manipulated by his corrupt campaign manager and is forced to temporarily cede power to his wife, a woman of integrity despite her shameful past.

Title: 283. Alye parusa
description: A little girl Assol met a wizard and it has been foretold: "... it will be a fine sunny day when a beautiful ship under scarlet sail comes and the noble prince will take you away from here. He'll take you to the world of your dreams, where you will be loved and happy." The neighbours told jokes about her, children teased her, but she waited for her prince. She trusted in the miracles and waited. Arthur Gray's rule was "if you can make a miracle, do it!". And he made a miracle for the wonderful romantic girl.

Title: 284. My Baby Is Black!
description: Daniel and Françoise are an interracial couple. When Daniel is introduced to Françoise's conservative family, their love for each other is soon tested as tensions rise between the two races.

Title: 285. The Silent Call
description: Young Guy Brancato's family moves from Nevada to California, leaving their dog Pete behind. Pete runs away and embarks on a journey to reunite with Guy in Los Angeles, while Guy searches for his missing pet.

Title: 286. Operation Bottleneck
description: WWII Burma...Six paratroopers undertake an extremely dangerous mission against the Japanese. It will ultimately cost them their lives, except for one "lucky" survivor.

Title: 287. My Son, the Hero
description: Reynaldo and Martín Del Hierro are witnesses of the murder of their father by Pascual Velazco, as they grow up they're poisoned by the desire of vengeance by their mother, but once they get it it'll change their lifes forever.

Title: 288. The Fascist
description: The quest of a Fascist soldier, whose mission is to catch a political enemy at the end of World War II.

Title: 289. Sasural
description: Shekhar lives a poor lifestyle along with his maternal uncle, Dharamdas; his aunt; a cousin, Sita - who is separated from her husband, Mahesh; and also has a sister, Gauri, who had eloped with her lover and everyone believes is dead. He studies in college along with wealthy fellow collegian, Bela. Both do not get along, but that changes when her dad comes to know about Shekhar's good character and thinks that he will be a suitable son-in-law. He approaches Dharamdas and arranges their marriage with the condition that Shekhar move in with his family, to which Dharamdas and Shekhar agree but Bela's mom is displeased as she would like her daughter to marry Rajan Murari, the son of their employee, Govindram. Despite of this, the marriage does take place and Shekhar moves in, is employed by Thakur, and the family settles down to a fairly harmonious relationship. Their idyllic lifestyle is shattered when Bela suspects, and then across evidence that Sita and Mahesh, who are now together, have stolen her diamond necklace; that Shekhar is having an affair with a dancing girl; that he has embezzled Rs.10,000/- and had gone to an undisclosed location for 3 days. Things get even worse when Thakur meets with an accident, and subsequently passes away - paving the way for his wife to arrange her daughter's divorce and Shekhar's death.

Title: 290. Dersu Uzala
description: The story of a russian explorer (Vladimir Arsenev) in the wilderness of Siberia and Dersu Uzala, a native guide on his trip.

Title: 291. The Tartars
description: Tartan and Viking forces clash in what is modern-day Russia.

Title: 292. Guns of the Trees
description: A depressed woman, Barbara, is on the verge of suicide while a man she meets in a church and a married couple try to convince her that life is worth living.

Title: 293. Goliath and the Vampires
description: Goliath must save the kidnapped women of his village from an evil zombie leader who needs their blood to feed his soldiers.

Title: 294. Don Camillo monsignore... ma non troppo
description: Don Camillo (now bishop) and Peppone (now senator) return to the town of Brescello and rekindle their friendly rivalry.

Title: 295. Vengeance of the Three Musketeers
description: To avenge her defeat and with the help of the Cardinal's army leader Rochefort, the treacherous Milady de Winter kidnaps both D'Artagnan and Constance, in order to spur a war between the French and the English, as per the Cardinal's wish.

Title: 296. Invasion of the Neptune Men
description: Clumsy invaders from Neptune are thwarted by hero Space Chief and a nondescript group of microshort-wearing Japanese kids.

Title: 297. A Cold Wind in August
description: An older woman seduces an impressionable working-class boy who falls deeply in love with her. Disillusionment sets in when the boy discovers that she is a stripper.

Title: 298. The Grand Olympics
description: 142 minutes of the film speak of events and athletes that have characterized the 1960 Summer Olympics in Rome.

Title: 299. Synoikia to Oneiro
description: The stories of poor people living in a neighborhood in Athens and their difficulties.

Title: 300. Alice in the Navy
description: The frustration of an unkept promise and an insuppressible youthful rebellion lead to an unprecedented act of love, as the daughter of the Hellenic Naval Academy's commander and a fourth-year cadet meet again in the strangest of places.

Title: 301. Once Upon a Knight
description: An insurance investigator who is allergic to naked women searches for a missing painting.

Title: 302. I Like Money
description: A poor but proud French teacher gets fired after refusing to modify the grades of a rich student. As this could be the opportunity to exploit his honesty, Castel Benac hires Topaze as a managing director for a shady business.

Title: 303. The Taste of Violence
description: After kidnapping the daughter of a local dictator, a revolutionary and his two lieutenants lead her through hostile territory in the hopes of exchanging her for their imprisoned comrades.

Title: 304. 7 Women from Hell
description: Seven women from different backgrounds, nationality, age, class, and marital status find themselves in New Guinea, February 1942 - when the Japanese army takes over unexpectedly, and sends them into a war camp in the jungle.

Title: 305. The Hellfire Club
description: Years after fleeing his ancestral home with his mother, Jason returns home to claim his birthright, only to find his way blocked by his evil cousin Thomas. In order to reclaim his title, Jason must do battle with his cousin, who calls upon the members of the deadly Hellfire Club to help him.

Title: 306. The Curse of Nostradamus
description: An aristocratic vampire swears an oath to kill the enemies who killed his father. In order to terrify them even further, he warns each one when he is coming for them.

Title: 307. Five Day Lover
description: As the lover of Madeleine, Antoine meets her best friend Claire. Antoine pretends to be rich, while Claire tells him that she is married to a diplomat. Both lovers enjoy these lies until one day Madeleine discovers the betrayal.

Title: 308. Atlas
description: Evil king Praximedes convinces superhero Atlas to fight for him, but Atlas eventually sees the king's true nature and turns against him.

Title: 309. The Secret of the Black Falcon
description: A secret document has fallen into the hands of pirates. Spain and England are both interested. The English commissioned a notorious pirate and the Spaniards procure their best officer, Carlos de Herrera, to retrieve the document for them.

Title: 310. Common Law Wife
description: Shugfoot, a rich old man, throws his longtime live-in mistress Linda out and moves his sexy young niece Jonelle (a.k.a. "Baby Doll") in, the latter of whom has just returned home upon being asked to do so by her uncle after making a living as both a stripper and a waitress at a local go-go bar in New Orleans, Louisiana. Linda, however, is not going to give up her man without a fight, and while Shugfoot tries to make peace between the two women, he does not realize at all that his seemingly innocent niece has her own plans for him.

Title: 311. Double Bunk
description: Newlyweds buy a houseboat after being conned. They fix it up and take friends on a river trip to Folkestone, but accidentally reach France instead. Stranded without fuel and supplies, they struggle to get back.

Title: 312. White Slave Ship
description: The Albatross travels from England to the New World in 1675, with a number of passengers, a couple of political prisoners along with a dozen other women convicts, these to be sold into slavery on arrival. The woman activist frees the dozen of low-cast women, and they take over the ship. After a storm, the captain takes back control of his ship. Since mutiny is punishable by death in the New World, the mutineers try to reroute the course, tossing Desny and Purdom in the brig. A practical male mutineer wants to throw the women overboard to save rations, but the women free Purdom and the captain to battle the mutineers. A British warship comes to the rescue, and the captain pardons Angeli and Purdom for having saved his life.

Title: 313. El jinete negro
description: The Black Horseman (1958). A cowboy dresses up as a vigilante and kills a bandit, but his true identity is uncovered.

Title: 314. All Hands on Deck
description: Follows a Navy ship that has a captain obsessed with catching a fish, a singing executive officer who wants to get married, and an Indian with a turkey as a pet.

Title: 315. Saint-Tropez Blues
description: The minute her parents leave, Anne-Marie drops out of school for an eight-day vacation in St-Tropez with her friend Jean-Paul. They are soon caught up in the whirlwind of St-Tropez life. Jean-Paul falls into the arms of a very wealthy woman while Anne-Marie goes off with a young man she met on the road. After a few misadventures, both friends realize they are in love with each other and meet in St-Tropez.

Title: 316. Daniella by Night
description: Daniella goes to Rome to replace a model who's been murdered. Count Castellani, her boss, is smitten with her and so is reporter Karl. When another model is killed in Castellani's house Daniella investigates trying to clear his name.

Title: 317. Armored Command
description: An American army unit is trapped in a small town during a German counterattack and discovers that a spy in the town is providing the Germans with information about them.

Title: 318. War Is Hell
description: During the Korean War, a glory-hunting sergeant leads his platoon on a mission against the enemy--not telling them that a cease-fire has just been declared--so that he can win medals. Trouble arises when some members of platoon begin to suspect that something is fishy.

Title: 319. Garibaldi
description: How Italy's historic national hero Giuseppe Garibaldi led a military campaign known as Expedition of the Thousand in 1860 and conquered Sicily and Naples.

Title: 320. Swingin' Along
description: An amateur tunesmith (Tommy Noonan) and a con man (Pete Marshall) pool their resources in order to win first prize in a songwriting contest

Title: 321. Man-Trap
description: Two Korean War veterans re-unite to pull off a heist at a San Francisco airport but find themselves running for their lives.

Title: 322. Sansone
description: While traveling through the kingdom of Sulom, Samson is arrested and finds that the queen no longer reigns and that a power-mad warlord and his army of mercenaries now controls the kingdom. Samson teams up with some of his one-time adversaries to battle the usurper and restore the rightful queen to power.

Title: 323. The Fantasy of Deer Warrior
description: The happy lives of animals in the forest are stirred by the sudden attack of a pack of wolves. The Father Deer comes to the rescue, and asks Birdy to notify his son, the Deer. When the Deer rushes to his father's side and before he dies he asks his son to seek revenge.

Title: 324. No Time for Ecstasy
description: A young man Michel, of Ukrainian origin, after fleeing the Red Army, he commits to Perpignan in the International Brigades fighting Franco.

Title: 325. The Devil's Daffodil
description: A Chinese detective breaks up a drug smuggling ring and tries to find the "Daffodil Killer". The drug smugglers had devised the ingenious method of smuggling heroin from Hong Kong in the stems of daffodils.

Title: 326. Gold of Rome
description: Rome 1943. The German Commandant of the city causes a turmoil in the Jewish community by offering them what seems to be an expensive way out of imprisonment and death.

Title: 327. His and Hers
description: Returned from North Africa, a British novelist is at odds with his wife when she insists on dividing the house and the domestic chores, and he goes mad after she starts writing his biography and flirting with his publisher.

Title: 328. Mother Courage and Her Children
description: In 17th-century Europe, a sutler struggles to keep her children alive as she follows various armies selling goods and her body to the soldiers.

Title: 329. Wa Islamah
description: Set in the 13th century, under their leader Timur, the Tartar hordes invade the Middle East and take over areas as widespread as Persia, Egypt, and Syria. A lowly woman from a harem rises to lead the Egyptians against the invaders.

Title: 330. The Catch
description: Towards the end of WWII, a black American pilot is captured and imprisoned by rural Japanese villagers, who await official instructions as to how to proceed with their "catch."

Title: 331. Gun Fight
description: On the stagecoach to Laramie, Wayne Santley rescues singer Nora Brown from the advances of gambler Cole Fender. In Laramie, Wayne discovers his brother Brad is an outlaw, but he refuses to join the gang of rustlers and sets up a homestead. He and Nora are married. Later Brad repents and joins his brother, but Brad's former partner Pawnee organizes an attack on the brothers. Despite the source that seems to think so, this was not an M-G-M production.

Title: 332. A Dance in the Rain
description: Peter is the dark brooding type. Leading a vacuous, shapeless life, he longs for the ideal woman, while at the same time, half heartedly continuing with his habitual girlfriend, Marusa , who is considerably older, a fact that Peter is quick to point out. As an ageing actress, struggling for parts in her local theatre, she oozes insecurity and breathes uncertainty. Together, they spend their time in the local restaurant, smoking, drinking and trading verbal blows. "I bet you'll just end up a drunk," she tells Peter each time. Peter just grins and tells her how old she looks. Compounded by a thankless director who soon shows her the door, Marusa finds her identity being squeezed harder and harder against the wall. To escape, Peter and Marusa dream...

Title: 333. The Dead One
description: A voodoo priestess sends out zombies to bring back live victims for her sacrificial rituals.

Title: 334. Hand in Hand
description: A little Roman Catholic boy and a little Jewish girl become best friends despite the prejudice that surrounds them.

Title: 335. The Big Gamble
description: Misadventures of an ambitious unlucky Irishman who goes on a long and arduous trip to Africa along with his wife and bumbling cousin in hopes of starting a trucking business there.

Title: 336. Scanty Panties
description: Ribald comedy routines with burlesque house comics, striptease acts and exotic dance numbers.

Title: 337. A Taste of Money
description: An old dear who's worked at an office for years handling large sums of cash gets a gang of robbers to blow the safe.

Title: 338. Muñecos infernales
description: Four men are cursed by a voodoo priest for stealing a sacred idol from his temple. Soon a band of murderous "doll men" are after the men and their families.

Title: 339. The Centurion
description: Greece, 146 A.D. in Corinth, the valiant efforts by Greek legions who seek freedom from Roman domination, the ensuing defeat by the Romans and the sacking of the city. Against this backdrop is woven a story of love, jealousy and intrigue.

Title: 340. Flame in the Streets
description: During the 1960s in Britain, tense race relations between whites and blacks are affecting the workplace, the family, the dating scene, and the society at large.

Title: 341. Young, Willing and Eager
description: Carol flees to London from her alcoholic stepfather, but runs into a rough crowd in her new home.

Title: 342. Third Sister Liu
description: This is the first musical film in China which tells the story of Liu San Jie (Liu the Third Sister), a legendary folk female singer of Zhuang minority in Guangxi Autonomous Region.

Title: 343. Jab Pyar Kisise Hota Hai
description: Nisha lives a very wealthy lifestyle in Neelgaon, India, with her businessman dad, Sardar Roop Singh. She is now of marriageable age, and her dad wants her to marry his friend's son, Sohan, but Nisha dislikes him. While traveling to Darjeeling with a dance troupe, she meets with her dad's business associates' son, Popat Lal, and after a few misadventures, both fall in love with each other. She takes him to meet her dad where he can also finalize his business transaction, but when Roop comes inside, he finds that Popat has disappeared, and in his place is another man claiming to be the real Popat. Nisha heart is broken and she starts to hate Popat. She does meet with Popat, who tells her that his real name is Sunder and both had been promised to each other by their respective parents, but Roop had subsequently changed his mind. Nisha believes him and agrees to marry him without her father's blessings. When the marriage is to take place, a man named Khanna comes over and tells Nisha that Sunder is already married to woman named Shanti, who he subsequently killed, and had been the primary accused in this case by the police. Watch what impact this news has on the marriage, and see what excuses Sunder now comes up with.

Title: 344. Totòtruffa '62
description: Antonio is a poor man who must support his daughter, especially providing the tuition for her stay at a prestigious boarding school where she can study dance.

Title: 345. Noli me tángere
description: Epic screen adaptation of the great Jose Rizal's novel, Noli Me Tangere (otherwise known as Touch Me Not or The Social Cancer) and was taken from a Bible verse.

Title: 346. Fate Takes a Hand
description: A 15-year-old stolen mailbag is discovered. The post office delivers its letters. A reporter and security officer track several deliveries that could impact recipients' lives.

Title: 347. Day by Day, Desperately
description: The mental illness that struck young Dario, one of the two children of the Dominici family who lives in a magnificent Roman palace, disrupts the life of all its members.

Title: 348. And Love Has Vanished
description: A young man falls in love with the girl who he met by accident.

Title: 349. What a Whopper
